items.title: For long-term investors, looking beyond the obvious: 5 large-cap stocks from different sectors with upside potential of up to 24%
items.description: An investor looking for a sound company often looks for two obvious moats: Price and margin. But there is another one that rewards close scrutiny. It is to be found in businesses that keep delivering even when most others in the field are struggling. It is a moat that protects them in the good years and also carries them through the bad ones.

items.title: Real estate stocks: Time for a tactical relocation? 10 stocks with an upside potential of up to 35%
items.description: In its operating matrix, the real estate sector is different from most sectors listed on the exchanges. In fact, a large part of the industry is still outside the listed space. Across the north, south and west, there are several large developers with marquee projects that are completely privately held. What this means is: You cannot look at the real estate sector only in terms of what 10 or 15 listed companies are saying. There is much more happening in the sector.
